data.notes: Following the user's 80/20 request, research was capped at 12 extended searches. The focus was on current generations and the main powertrains (combustion/diesel, plug-in hybrid, BEV), because plug-in hybrids are the most common source of differing trunk volumes. Data come mainly from ADAC, angurten.de, carwow, AUTO BILD and JESMB; no official Mercedes press kit was found. Predecessor generations (S213, X253, C118) are only partly covered, and W205/S205 is missing completely. Added models: A-Klasse Limousine and CLA Shooting Brake. Not covered: the electric GLC with EQ technology. Diesels in the current generations are 48-V mild hybrids; they are tagged mhev or diesel depending on the source context. Known conflicts: GLC PHEV 470 vs 463 l; C-Klasse sedan height 1446 (angurten) vs a lower official figure; CLA height 1450 vs 1468.
